registration_boundary: Registered after the complete surface-v2 generation, Smatch scores, and release gate were known. This sidecar freezes descriptive paired inference over all 128 fixed source-order rows; it is not a preregistered confirmatory analysis.

paired_statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each binary metric across comparisons

claim_boundary: The report quantifies the already frozen h=48 stress window. It can support paired mechanism and bounded-rescue claims for this fixed window, including regressions and ties. It cannot estimate unrestricted-test semantic gains, turn post-hoc intervals into preregistered evidence, or attribute WF-versus-WWCD quality differences when their predictions are identical.
